headline: 793 dead in measles outbreak: 5 more die in 24 hours
summary: The death toll from the ongoing measles outbreak has risen to 793, with five additional fatalities reported in a single day.
details: A measles outbreak has claimed 793 lives, with five more deaths reported within the last 24 hours.

Health officials are monitoring the situation as the outbreak continues to spread.

headline: 372 hospitalized as three more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: A surge in dengue cases continues to put pressure on the healthcare system as hundreds are admitted to hospitals within a single day.
details: Three more people have died from dengue fever within a 24-hour period, according to reports.
In the same timeframe, 372 patients were hospitalized due to the virus, highlighting a significant spike in infections.
The rapid increase in hospitalizations indicates a growing public health challenge as the disease spreads.
Authorities and health officials are urging the public to take necessary precautions to prevent mosquito breeding and protect themselves from bites.
